description: 3eAI SDLC hook configuration (free edition). Five hooks, each active only in the stages and modes of hooks/_phase_policy.py: (1) UserPromptSubmit shows unresolved Stop-hook findings and gate-flagged tool calls before each prompt, and first a 3EAI-SDLC ROUTE block naming the skill to enter when the phase marker is missing, unknown or ahead of the project's stage in a project with deliverables (hooks/_project_state.py); (2) Stop scans the last turn of the transcript with pattern heuristics and writes findings to .sentinel/runtime/audit_log.json; (3) PreToolUse: forced_rule_set_gate, once switched on with sentinel-lock, denies destructive commands and asks the user before an outward one (git push, a publish, mail); pivot_interceptor denies an edit of a file the session wrote after a failing pytest run; (4) side_effect_check tells the agent which files a shell command changed that it does not name. The 3EAI-SDLC ROUTE block is the one output outside the declared stages. All hooks fail open; a failure is logged to .sentinel/runtime/hook_errors.jsonl and flagged on the next prompt.
